cur-fossil-tabon.dateNote: In 1962 Robert Fox's team found a human skullcap in these caves on Palawan: "Tabon Man", among the oldest modern humans in the Philippines. Bones here are up to about 47,000 years old (0.047 million years).
cur-fossil-tabon.summary: The Palawan caves where "Tabon Man", among the oldest humans in the Philippines, was found.

cur-find-jeriji-saleh.dateNote: A painting of a wild cattle-like animal in this Borneo cave is at least 40,000 years old, among the oldest known pictures of animals (Aubert et al., Nature, 2018).
